take: Playoffs aren't safe (12.6%). Win now beats playoff matchups right now.

Backup plan: Kyren Williams for Justin Jefferson (Jaxsens team ), +2.3.
Swing big if they bite: Bijan Robinson for Jonah Coleman + DeVonta Smith (Warrent Acquired ) is worth +5.1, but it hurts their lineup so expect a no unless they're desperate.
Biggest risk: Chuba Hubbard getting hurt costs you 1.2 points of title odds. Make sure you have a real backup there.
Waivers: Buccaneers D/ST (D) for Ravens D/ST adds about 67.1 weighted lineup points.
